the SEZ population is net inhibitory onto the path under both a type-prefix and an anatomical definition, so scaling amplifies inhibition with excitation

M4_uniform_manipulations_tested.manipulation: uniform tonic depolarisation + membrane noise (3-6 mV)
M4_uniform_manipulations_tested.result: MN9 responds but so does the wind control (specificity lost) and the escape response is abolished

conclusion: taste -> MN9 in MaleCNS is disinhibitory; a silent network cannot express that, and no uniform manipulation restores it with specificity. Reproducing feeding needs cell-specific spontaneous activity, i.e. the state-dependent modulation this model omits (cf. Shiu et al. 2024, which reported the same limitation for inhibitory neurons at 0 Hz baseline).
